text:
ajay: FYI kicking off kubeadm cluster priming in eu-central-2 (on-prem rack). goal: GPU nodepools + base addons, then hand off to SRE for monitoring and cost checks.

maria: noted. do we have quota/firmware checks for the A100 blades?

ravi: waiting on firmware from hw team, but network VLANs are ready. i ran `lspci` on one host earlier, hw looks ok.

ajay: great. plan for this thread: 1) kubeadm init config + certs, 2) CNI (calico), 3) GPU device plugin + drivers, 4) nodepool taints/labels, 5) core addons (metrics-server, kube-state-metrics, prometheus node-exporter), 6) ingress controller, 7) smoke validation, 8) handoff checklist.

sara: add cert-manager to list. we'll need it for internal webhooks.

maria: +1 cert-manager. Also suggest enabling admission webhook for the GPU device plugin to avoid evictions.

ravi: quick note on kubeadm config I used:
```yaml
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: ClusterConfiguration
kubernetesVersion: v1.27.4
controlPlaneEndpoint: "lb.euc2.internal:6443"
networking:
  podSubnet: "10.244.0.0/16"
  serviceSubnet: "10.96.0.0/12"
---
apiVersion: kubeproxy.config.k8s.io/v1alpha1
kind: KubeProxyConfiguration
mode: ipvs
```

ajay: looks good. we should pin kube-proxy to ipvs for performance. remember to set sysctl net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=1 on all nodes.

infra-bot: (automated) cluster certs generated: /etc/kubernetes/pki/tls.crt, expires in 1y 364d.

maria: GPU drivers path: we'll use nvidia-driver-installer DaemonSet + nvidia-container-toolkit apt repo. quick deploy snippet: 
```bash
kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin/v0.12.0/nvidia-device-plugin.yml
helm repo add nvidia https://nvidia.github.io/gpu-operator
helm install gpu-operator nvidia/gpu-operator --namespace gpu-ops --create-namespace
```

ravi: remember we need NVIDIA kernel modules on hosts. use boot script: `sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-525` then reboot.

ajay: nodal plan for labels/taints: gpu=true, accelerator=nvidia; taint: dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule. that way scheduling is explicit.

sara: ingress: we'll use nginx for now with TLS via cert-manager. remember to open LB ports 80/443 on edge firewall.

maria: network policy: baseline deny-all, allow DNS, kube-system, and node-exporter -> prometheus. calico policy will be applied after cluster up.

ravi: cost note: rack power for GPUs is ~9k USD/month for the initial 8 A100s. caller: finance asked to track this under project 'gpu-euc2-priming'.

ajay: good to note. now smoke tests (commands):
```bash
# create test namespace
kubectl create ns smoke-test
# schedule tiny pod with gpu request
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: cuda-smoke
  namespace: smoke-test
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "dedicated"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "gpu"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  containers:
  - name: cuda-sample
    image: nvidia/cuda:11.8.0-base-ubuntu22.04
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","nvidia-smi && sleep 30"]
EOF
```

infra-bot: (automated) smoke pod `cuda-smoke` scheduled to node-07-gpu. status: Pending -> Running (30s). logs: `nvidia-smi` ok.

maria: if smoke passes, proceed to install cert-manager and prometheus stack.

ajay: list of acceptance items before handoff: 
- all control-plane nodes healthy (kubectl get cs)
- kube-proxy ipvs verified
- calico pods Running
- device-plugin Running and pods get GPUs
- metrics-server scraping kubelets
- prometheus node-exporter on all nodes
- ingress reachable and certs valid
- CNI network policies applied
- SSH access and runbooks handed to SRE

sara: SRE checklist addition: ensure logging (fluentd -> central ES) has GPU host logs and driver errors ingestion.

ravi: pre-handoff cost validation: enable per-node tagging with billing tag: `billing:gpu-euc2-priming` so finance can attribute.

ajay: timeline: tomorrow 03:00 UTC we run node driver installs, 04:00 kubeadm join for worker pool, 05:00 smoke run. ping me when drivers finished.

maria: I'll be on call for the driver window.

sara: I'll set up cert-manager Helm chart and nginx ingress chart after smoke.

deploy-bot: (scheduled job) runbook snapshot saved to /runbooks/gpu-euc2-priming/1819000123-snapshot.yaml

ajay: cool. post-handoff: create a short KB for on-call with troubleshooting steps for GPU OOMs, device-plugin restarts, and network partition recovery.

ravi: noted. one more: test pod eviction behaviour by killing kubelet on a worker and ensuring pods reschedule to other gpu nodes — we should document fallback capacity.

maria: also enable kubelet eviction thresholds: `--eviction-hard=memory.available<200Mi,nodefs.available<10%` and tune for GPU memory pressure if needed.

ajay: thanks team. I'll update the priming runbook with these items and ping SRE for handoff once the smoke tests complete. :thumbsup:

sara: ack. updating the runbook now. will attach helm values.

infra-bot: (automated) thread archived to project 'gpu-euc2-priming' after last message.
